style.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal textured backdrop #1E1B18 for hero and info shots, warm off-white #F5F1E8 panels for spec and comparison alternation
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons in one accent color, simple rounded labels
style.lightingSystem: soft top light with gentle contact shadows, warm color temperature, moist appetizing highlights on food, no harsh plastic speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium festive fresh-crab ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal background #1E1B18, warm crab-shell orange #C8501E, champagne gold accent #D4A017 and warm off-white text #F5F1E8; warm soft lighting with soft top light and gentle contact shadows, realistic moist food texture with natural steam, never plastic-looking; bold Chinese serif-style headlines in one family only; consistent rounded info labels and thin-line icons; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no plastic-looking food.
style.presentationRules: stable product scale, whole cooked crab reads glossy orange-red in every shot, hero features never covered by props
style.surfaceSystem: matte dark stone or textured charcoal board, occasional round dark ceramic plate and bamboo steamer wood
style.typography: bold Chinese serif-style headlines in one family only, warm off-white #F5F1E8 or champagne gold #D4A017
